senses.definition: Mainly aimed at or concerned with a particular thing.
senses.caution: It needs a partner word, as in customer-oriented or goal-oriented. Alone it is vague, and a long string of such words reads like a job ad.
senses.example: We are a customer-oriented team, so every release starts from a support ticket.

cues.text: In a performance review your manager says you catch small errors others miss. She calls you detail-___, using the word that also describes a map turned to face north.
A job posting asks for a service-___ person who puts customers first. What word completes the compound, the one that also describes a map turned to face north?
Your friend plans every holiday around food, so you call her food-___, using the word for a person whose main focus is one thing.

distractors: Not saying what you really think, in order to avoid a quarrel with someone.
Spread over many different areas instead of one.
Able to be used again without a different result each time.
Done in a way that is hidden from other people.
